environment: Xvfb GNOME Shell 46.0 (X11), PyQt6 UI, Orca 46.1 (speech logged, no audio)

results.name: opening the panel announces the placement grid and how to use it
results.detail: said: ['Fractile panel conn-screen-1600x1200 frame.', 'Placement grid, 6 by 6. Arrow keys choose a cell, Shift and arrow keys grow the selection, Enter places the window.']

results.name: moving the selection with the keyboard reads the chosen columns and rows
results.detail: said: ['left shift', 'left shift']; Orca dropped the grid's name changes: this Qt sends the AT-SPI accessible-name change without the new name (seen with Qt 6.4; Qt 6.10 sends it)

results.name: Tab through Settings: every control that takes focus is announced by name (no bare role), and the shortcut recorder says what it sets and its keys
results.detail: 12 controls focused; unnamed []; bare roles spoken []; recorder ['Show/hide panel shortcut: not assigned']; focused: ['page tab list: General', 'check box: Start Fractile when I log in', 'check box: Show icon in the system tray (when the desktop provides one)', 'check box: Show/hide panel shortcut: not assigned', 'push button: Clear', 'check box: Show a panel on every monitor', 'check box: Close the panel after placing a window (hold Shift to do the opposite)', 'check box: Repeating a shortcut moves the window to the next monitor', 'spin button: Repeat window', 'check box: Warn when an automatic tiling manager is active (Fractile never changes its settings)', 'check box: Show the key hints at the bottom of the panel', 'push button: Restore defaults for this page']

results.name: the command palette announces its search field, and moving down reads a command
